exercises.question: Which sentence uses a narrative time connector accurately to pace past urban change?
options: Apenas se anunció el nuevo tren urbano, subió el valor del suelo urbano.
Apenas se anuncie el nuevo tren urbano, subió el valor del suelo urbano.
Al cabo de que se anunció el nuevo tren urbano, subió el valor del suelo urbano.
Conforme crezca la plusvalía, bajaba la oferta asequible.

exercises.sentence: _____ crecía la plusvalía en el centro, la vivienda se volvía menos asequible para los trabajadores.
exercises.english: As capital gains grew in the centre, housing became less affordable for workers.

exercises.sentence: En cuanto se _____ el alquiler regulado, muchos inquilinos tendrán mayor estabilidad en la zona residencial.
exercises.english: As soon as regulated rent is approved, many tenants will have greater stability in the residential area.

exercises.sentence: Al cabo de una década, la burbuja inmobiliaria había encarecido toda la zona residencial.
options: After a decade, the housing bubble had driven up prices across the whole residential area.
After a month, the housing bubble had driven up prices across the whole residential area.
After a decade, the housing bubble had lowered prices across the whole residential area.

exercises.question: Which term refers to the increase in a property's market value over time?
options: la plusvalía
el alquiler regulado
el suelo urbano
la vivienda social

exercises.question: According to the first paragraph, what happened as soon as the coastal avenue renovation was announced?
options: Real-estate investors began buying whole buildings and the price of urban land rose rapidly.
The municipality immediately froze all rents and banned holiday rentals in the historic centre.
Local workshops expanded into neighbouring districts to take advantage of lower rents.

exercises.question: What consequence of rising capital gains does the third paragraph describe?
options: Public transport lines between the metropolitan outskirts and the historic centre became faster and cheaper.
Long-time tenants faced evictions or moved to the outskirts, leaving several central streets depopulated outside peak tourist hours.
The housing stock in the historic centre was converted mainly into social housing for young workers.

exercises.question: What urban model do planners advocate in the closing paragraphs of the report?
options: Endless urban sprawl in distant outskirts supported mainly by private car travel.
Replacing all old residential blocks with new luxury towers funded by property speculation.
A compact city based on renovating existing housing stock, social housing, regulated rent and urban mobility.

prompt.speaker: Carlos
prompt.text: ¿Crees que el nuevo alquiler regulado tendrá efecto rápido en el barrio?

options: En cuanto se apruebe la norma, los precios del suelo urbano empezarán a estabilizarse poco a poco.
En cuanto se aprobó la norma, los precios del suelo urbano empezarán a estabilizarse poco a poco.
Al cabo de se apruebe la norma, los precios del suelo urbano empezarán a estabilizarse poco a poco.

exercises.english: After ten years, the housing bubble had driven up prices in the residential area.

exercises.question: Which sentence contrasts a past parallel trend with a future policy projection correctly?
options: Conforme subía la plusvalía, faltaba vivienda asequible; en cuanto se apruebe el alquiler regulado, la situación podrá mejorar.
Conforme subiera la plusvalía, faltaba vivienda asequible; en cuanto se apruebe el alquiler regulado, la situación podrá mejorar.
Conforme subía la plusvalía, faltaba vivienda asequible; en cuanto se aprueba el alquiler regulado, la situación podrá mejorar.
Al cabo de subía la plusvalía, faltaba vivienda asequible; en cuanto se apruebe el alquiler regulado, la situación podrá mejorar.
